items.problem: The test requires a device timezone offset of 9 hours and line 225 requires offset 0, but `## DEV` (line 205) has only `set_test_device_language`. skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:362 reads the offset from `Time.get_time_zone_from_system()`, and skills/core/SKILL.md:207 writes DEV operations only in `## DEV`. The spec gives a core test no operation to set the offset, so these items depend on the time zone of the host that runs them

The display name is the `get_text` result of `name_key`, and line 93 makes every `get_text` replace input prompt tokens through `InputCore.get_prompt`. Neither skills/client-core/modules/input-core.md:254 nor skills/data/SKILL.md:254 forbids an input prompt token in the `name` text of `input_prompt`. Input: a `name` of `{action:jump}` on the row that `jump` resolves to makes `get_text` call itself with no end, and no document sets a result for it

`bind_text` on an element that is already bound and `unbind_text` on an element that is not bound are not set in `### text binding` or `## error`. An implementation can replace the key, keep the first key or leave an error log, and `## test` does not fix one of these

`bind_text` and `unbind_text` (localization-core.md:33-34, 127) do not set the result for an element that is null, already freed, or not a UI text element (e.g. a Godot `TextureRect`; the Godot rules list text nodes only for text scale, godot.md:403). There is no `## error` row for it, so one implementation can crash on a freed object, another ignore it silently, another leave an error log
